entries.title: Job 27:1
segments: ¶Moreover Job continued his discourse, and said:

entries.title: Job 27:2
segments: "[As] God lives, [who] has taken away my justice, And the Almighty, [who] has made my soul bitter,

entries.title: Job 27:3
segments: As long as my breath [is] in me, And the breath of God in my nostrils,

entries.title: Job 27:4
segments: My lips will not speak wickedness, Nor my tongue utter deceit.

entries.title: Job 27:5
segments: Far be it from me That I should say you are right; Till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

entries.title: Job 27:6
segments: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; My heart shall not reproach [me] as long as I live.

entries.title: Job 27:7
segments: ¶"May my enemy be like the wicked, And he who rises up against me like the unrighteous.

entries.title: Job 27:8
segments: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, Though he may gain [much], If God takes away his life?

entries.title: Job 27:9
segments: Will God hear his cry When trouble comes upon him?

entries.title: Job 27:10
segments: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call on God?

entries.title: Job 27:11
segments: ¶"I will teach you about the hand of God; What [is] with the Almighty I will not conceal.

entries.title: Job 27:12
segments: Surely all of you have seen [it]; Why then do you behave with complete nonsense?

entries.title: Job 27:13
segments: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, received from the Almighty:

entries.title: Job 27:14
segments: If his children are multiplied, [it is] for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Job 27:15
segments: Those who survive him shall be buried in death, And their widows shall not weep,

entries.title: Job 27:16
segments: Though he heaps up silver like dust, And piles up clothing like clay-

entries.title: Job 27:17
segments: He may pile [it] up, but the just will wear [it], And the innocent will divide the silver.

entries.title: Job 27:18
segments: He builds his house like a moth, Like a booth [which] a watchman makes.

entries.title: Job 27:19
segments: The rich man will lie down, But not be gathered [up]; He opens his eyes, And he [is] no more.

entries.title: Job 27:20
segments: Terrors overtake him like a flood; A tempest steals him away in the night.

entries.title: Job 27:21
segments: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; It sweeps him out of his place.

entries.title: Job 27:22
segments: It hurls against him and does not spare; He flees desperately from its power.

entries.title: Job 27:23
segments: [Men] shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
